data.name: Avanish
data.gender_notes: Avanish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avanish is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ava' meaning 'away' and 'nis' meaning 'to destroy'. This name signifies the removal of ignorance and the revealing of truth. In Hindu mythology, Avanish is also the name of a god associated with the destruction of illusions and the revelation of the true nature of reality. The name Avanish carries the meaning “Destroyer of Illusions” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avanish usually hope their child will grow to embody destroyer of illusions and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remover of illusion and revealer of truth
data.etymology: Avanish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Destroyer of Illusions.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avanish total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
